title: Predicting benefit from immune checkpoint inhibitors in patients with non-small-cell lung cancer by CT-based ensemble deep learning: a retrospective study
summary: An ensemble of four CT-based deep-learning subnetworks predicts progression-free and overall survival after immune-checkpoint inhibition in metastatic NSCLC, compared with conventional clinical/radiological risk models and external cohorts. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
